label: Yogyakarta
short_description: The Central Java cultural capital near Borobudur and Prambanan.
intro: Yogyakarta's coverage in this directory is centered on the Central Java city that is the heartland of Javanese culture -- the Kraton sultanate, batik and the nearby UNESCO temples of Borobudur and Prambanan. Hotels here suit culture and heritage travel, a short drive from the city centre and reached via Yogyakarta International Airport (YIA).
